text: A function f: A → B is injective precisely when:
choices: every b ∈ B has at least one preimage
explanation: Injectivity says distinct inputs give distinct outputs, i.e. f(a) = f(b) ⇒ a = b. The two middle options describe surjectivity, and 'a = b implies f(a) = f(b)' is well-definedness, which every function satisfies.
